## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] `composer ci:check` is green.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased` if an operator can see the change, with an
      **Upgrade note** when they have to do something.
- [ ] New user-facing strings have their Italian translation in `lang/it.json`.
- [ ] The README says what changed for a setting, a command or a behaviour operators rely on.
- [ ] No released migration was edited.
